name: Maxxus Bellevue 3-Person Near-Zero EMF Far Infrared Sauna
description: Maxxus Bellevue 3-Person Near-Zero EMF (Under 3 mg) Far Infrared Sauna (Canadian Hemlock) Looking for a way to bring the spa experience right into your home? The Maxxus Bellevue 3-Person Near Zero EMF FAR Infrared Sauna creates the perfect environment for relaxation, detoxification, and overall wellness. Designed to comfortably fit up to three people, it offers a shared space for family or friends to unwind together. Crafted from natural Canadian Hemlock and enhanced with advanced infrared technology, this sauna blends durability, elegance, and modern innovation. Its thoughtful design transforms any room into a wellness retreat, supporting stress relief and rejuvenation with every session. Features: Near-zero EMF - EMF under 3 mg when sitting 2 to 3 inches from the heating panel Full 3-person capacity 7 PureTech™ Near Zero EMF (EMF Under 2MG when sitting 2 to 3 inches from the heating panels) FAR Infrared Carbon heating panels Natural Reforested Canadian Hemlock wood construction Clear Tempered glass door Interior chromotherapy lighting system with Red Light Feature Standard with Floor - Feet Reflexology Heater Roof vent Interior LED Control Panel Bluetooth and MP3 auxiliary connection with built in speakers 118F-132F is the ideal temperature range, sauna can heat up to 140F Clasp together assembly Ships in 3 boxes Specifications: Sauna weight: 315 lbs. Shipping weight: 400 lbs. Electrical service: Special Electrical 120 V/20 AMP Non GFCI dedicated receptacle and breaker (Not 220/240 V) (Please consult a certified electrician.) Exterior dimensions (LWH): 42" x 61" x 75" Interior dimensions (LWH): 38" x 57" x 68" Document: View Owner's Manual
